dataset.name: Moffitt resected lung squamous-cell carcinoma cohort (2019)
dataset.description: Independent resected lung squamous-cell carcinoma cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA-seq and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The publication cohort contains 108 treatment-naive primary lung squamous-cell carcinomas resected at Moffitt Cancer Center. Every promoted patient contributes one tumor expression profile, exact vital status and overall-survival time from specimen collection.

metadata.source_program: Moffitt Total Cancer Care lung squamous-cell carcinoma cohort
metadata.source_data_system: Europe PMC open supplementary files, cross-referenced to NCBI GEO GSE289256
metadata.library_method: Primary-tumor RNA-seq aligned to hs37d5 with TopHat2, quantified against RefSeq with HTSeq and normalized in the source analysis with DESeq2
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival from specimen collection
metadata.endpoint_caveat: TRACE Explorer preserves the published Overall_Survival_2__Days_ field and final vital status. It does not reinterpret this source endpoint as TCGA-CDR OS.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Supplementary Data 1 provides 108 unique patient IDs, final vital status, exact overall-survival time in days, AJCC 7 stage and differentiation grade. The source analysis code explicitly models overall survival from specimen collection.
metadata.sample_linkage_note: The 108 SCC identifiers in Supplementary Data 1 match the 108 expression columns in Supplementary Data 4 exactly and one-to-one. GSE289256 later released expected counts for 116 libraries; TRACE Explorer uses the publication-aligned 108-patient matrix so no inferred mapping or controlled dbGaP data are required.
metadata.expression_curation_note: Supplementary Data 4 contains 19,559 unique source symbols on the publication's normalized expression scale. A total of 8,065 rows contain at least one source NA and are excluded without imputation, leaving 11,494 complete gene rows. TRACE Explorer applies no additional transformation.
metadata.overlap_note: This institutionally defined Moffitt cohort is independent of TCGA-LUSC and the registered CPTAC-LUSC release.
metadata.redistribution_note: The article and its supplementary files are distributed under CC BY 4.0. Source file hashes and the exact retained feature set are recorded in the release manifest.

samples.sample_role: Treatment-naive resected primary lung squamous-cell carcinoma

expression.label: Published normalized RNA-seq expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 19,559 source symbols are unique under case-normalized comparison. Features with any source NA are excluded rather than imputed.
expression.scale_note: Values are preserved on the publication's normalized expression scale. They support within-cohort relative analysis and must not be interpreted as TPM or compared numerically across studies.

endpoints.label: Overall survival from specimen collection
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to the source final vital-status field
